name: file-write
description: Create or fully overwrite a file. Parent directories are auto-created. Overwriting requires --force so stale content is never silently destroyed; --append appends instead.
use_when: creating a new file or fully rewriting an existing one

args.name: content
args.description: Inline content, or '-' / omitted to read stdin.

args.name: --force
args.description: Required to overwrite an existing file.
